evidenceBoundary.direct: Named decoded call targets and selected metadata field-offset accesses in exact .pdata bodies and unwind-owned fragments; typed inheritance and declared override absence where specified.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Native default bodies only; runtime IFix selection and actual activation remain unobserved. Offset-access checks alone do not prove receiver type or complete control/data flow.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Server decision rules, Mission quest to LevelScript task ownership, asynchronous request/reply ownership, unvisited routes and successful returns.

copiedObjectiveState.contract: The complete normal Copy caller program preserves incoming source/destination aliases through checked usage initialization, clears the values dictionary and loops over the incoming values map, copies the root completion flag, clears extraDetails and allocates a fresh ConditionDetail per incoming detail. Its nested hash loop fills that detail before the outer Add. Every current-helper program, MoveNext interface search/invocation, argument lane, loop backedge and normal cleanup exit is checked with selected field types/offsets and exact passed MethodSpecs. The nested hash transfer preserves low 64-bit return-window arguments from an unsigned source context into Dictionary<long,bool>.Add with no caller arithmetic/range check. The proof is conditional on unpatched dispatch, normal usage/class resolution, valid objects/interface tables/current returns, successful collection/allocation/cleanup calls, Win64 ABI and no external alias mutation. It does not prove closed pair field layout, enumerator/collection/helper bodies, exceptional/fallback behavior, live map values or quest ownership. Copying completion/count data is separate from quest-state handoff.

compareStoredProgress.contract: The default comparison reads the selected receiver's virtual comparison operator, current progress and target, then calls DoCompare. It is separate from cached m_result and does not prove live values or a server completion rule. A complete normal base caller program checks the false patch guard and passes virtual comparator/progress/target returns to the typed Int32 comparison, without reading the cached result or querying a quest/mission ID. Overrides and progress provenance remain separate.

storedObjectiveValue.contract: The default body passes its stored condition id and values dictionary to GetValueOrDefault. This lookup is separate from objective display aggregation and does not attribute an incoming packet to a live condition.

combineDisplayedProgress.contract: The default body enumerates the stored children and dispatches their progress-for-show getter through its selected metadata slot. Accumulation and objective branch selection require the separately reviewed body flow.

combineDisplayedTarget.contract: The default body enumerates the stored children and dispatches their target-for-show getter through its selected metadata slot. This presentation target is distinct from the incoming values dictionary.

objectiveShowData.contract: The owned default body fragments call the objective presentation getters and write separate current and target fields on the display record. Field-offset predicates alone do not prove every receiver or the completion-dependent choice of value.
